Author: Valentina Vieri
Name: VieriNexus
Punchline: Record, refine, preview, and safely play Nexus-owned routes.
Description: The unified, modular Vieri suite in active development. Routes & Navigation now provides timed route recording, detailed point editing, duplicate and safe clipboard exchange, persistent world preview, guarded same-zone travel/playback, verified Stop, manual takeover, reload recovery, and cross-plugin path yielding. VieriNavPlotter must be unloaded manually before Nexus movement can be approved.
